medkit.name: medkit
medkit.description: A white box with a red cross.

pickup.text: You patch yourself up with a medkit. (+25)
A stimpack. (+10)
You put on the armour vest. (100)
A clip. (+10 bullets)
Four shells.

key_x.name: x key
key_x.description: Execute permission, on a blue card.

pickup.text: You have execute permission: the --x key.
You got the shotgun! (3)
You got the chaingun! (4)

sudo_orb.name: sudo
sudo_orb.description: A glowing sphere with a # in it.

pickup.text: sudo -s. You are root for 15 beats: nothing can hurt you.

boots.name: hazmat boots
boots.description: Yellow rubber, knee high, a black band. The acid cannot get through them - for a while.

pickup.text: Hazmat boots! Acid will not hurt you for 20 beats in it.

armor_ring0.name: ring-0 armour
armor_ring0.description: Blue, kernel mode. Nothing in user space gets through it easily.

pickup.text: Ring-0 armour: kernel mode. (200)

goggles.name: TTY goggles
goggles.description: Two green screens on a strap. The world as a terminal sees it.

pickup.text: TTY goggles! You see the world the way the terminal does - and what is hollow shows. (F2 or `goggles` takes them off and saves the battery.)

key_w.name: w key
key_w.description: Write permission, on a yellow card.

pickup.text: You have write permission: the -w- key.

shovel.name: shovel
shovel.description: A trenching tool, standard issue for boarding troops. The edge is sharpened.

pickup.text: A shovel: standard issue, the edge sharpened. It shares key 1 with your fists - press 1 again for the next.

chainsaw.name: chainsaw
chainsaw.description: A cutting saw from a damage-control locker. Whatever it bites stops what it was doing.

pickup.text: A chainsaw from a damage-control locker. It starts first pull. (Key 1; again for the next.)

rocket_launcher.name: rocket launcher
rocket_launcher.description: A shoulder tube from the facility's own armoury. Do not stand near what you hit.

pickup.text: You got the rocket launcher! (5)  Mind the blast: it reaches a cell round what you hit.
Two rockets.

grenades.name: grenades
grenades.description: A box of three fragmentation grenades.

pickup.text: A box of grenades. (6)  Thrown three cells ahead; they bounce off walls and go off a beat later.

fuel.name: fuel cell
fuel.description: A sealed cell of hopper fuel, still warm.

pickup.text: A fuel cell: 12 beats of flight. It goes into the first machine that needs it.

fuel_drop.name: supply drop
fuel_drop.description: A Mandate supply drop, parachute and all: hopper fuel.

pickup.text: A Mandate supply drop - fuel! 12 more beats in the air.
